task.description:
Gate before code for REQ-070, FIRST pass (maximum three passes: first and two repeats; a third FAIL means ORCH stops and asks the owner). Check the design docs/design/REQ-070-demo-tenants-v3.md yourself, do not trust its statements. Read: the block REQ-070 in docs/requirements.yaml as amended by run MA070-20261027-01 (SEP allowed as a reason, criterion 2; the amendment passed its gate), decisions/0086 and 0085, docs/design/REQ-069-tenant-look-format.md, the sample docs/design/samples/picker-v3-approved-2026-10-26/ (data.js), the existing demo tenants and tests.
Check: (1) every criterion 1-7 maps to a named test with an oracle independent of the code (own contrast function, literals; the sample loaded with a substituted window); quality-bar items named in the block each have a check; (2) no implementation code in the design; the design can be built without guessing: the exact tables of solutions, rules, hypotheses and result settings, the data per option and the id renames are present and consistent with the engine (REQ-055) and the check (REQ-069); (3) repeat the design's trials yourself on a fresh clone of the tag base/DEMO070-20261027-01 in the session scratchpad folder named in the launching message: place sketch files of the two tenants as the design describes, run `npm run picker -- check` on them and the engine on the answer sets: the results (exit codes, the line «вопросов 5, решений M, правил K», the leader/close/none results per language, the replacement colours' contrast 3.13 and 3.10, the rejected sample colours 2.90 and 2.46, the E_FIELD for the `?` tag) must equal the design's statements; (4) run the old tests with the new files placed in the copy (the whole `npm run check`, once): which turn red? the design says none; (5) the table of text edits (at most six rows) is complete: run the real check on every ru, kk, en text of the sample after the path map and confirm that only the rows listed fail; find yourself the texts shared by the two tenants in any language (criterion 4) and confirm the design lists every one of them (the design names E2 and E3 for the agency roles; are there others, in kk or en, in options, in quick numbers, in names, in the staff lines?); (6) the criterion-to-test table includes a test that every `SEP` row's «was» text stands in both sample tenants (finding F1 of the amendment gate); (7) apply the design's mutants yourself on your copy: at least eight of the 28, one at a time, each must make a test fail — since the tests do not exist yet, instead check that each mutant is a concrete change with a named test that would catch it, and apply at least five of them to the sketch data to confirm that the real check or the engine detects them where the design says; (8) the sub-steps are in a buildable order and name their write sets; the questions for ORCH are answered by decisions/0086 and the design agrees with it; (9) no machine paths and no project names in the design or in your handoff (say "the traces list"). Verdict PASS or FAIL with findings (severity, place, fix). Change only your handoff. No commits, no git checkout/reset/stash/clean (also not in scratch copies). 16 GB RAM computer: single commands, one run at a time.
